data_objects.name: vehicle_fuel_economy_records
data_objects.meaning: Vehicle-level fuel-economy and powertrain records with engine size, horsepower, weight, acceleration, model-year, and origin attributes.
data_objects.notes: The table contains no explicit vehicle identifier or model-name field.

variables.name: displacement
variables.meaning: Engine displacement in an unspecified volume unit.

variables.name: weight
variables.meaning: Vehicle weight in an unspecified mass or force unit.

variables.name: acceleration
variables.meaning: Vehicle acceleration-performance measure in an undocumented convention.

variables.name: origin
variables.meaning: Integer-coded vehicle-origin category with no supplied label mapping.

structure.description: Each row describes one vehicle record; no column is established as a row identifier.
Rows are grouped in non-decreasing modelyear order. Origin is categorical despite its integer representation.

uncertainties: The units for displacement, weight, and acceleration are not declared.
The geographic mapping of origin codes and the century expansion of modelyear codes are not included.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
